title: Nintendo Classics Game Boy library adds Avenging Spirit, Mole Mania and Pinball: Revenge of the 'Gator on 27 Oct
game: Avenging Spirit / Mole Mania / Pinball: Revenge of the 'Gator

Nintendo of America's new trailer is YouTube-only (no download route); the Avenging Spirit video on Nintendo's EU page is the 2022 arcade version, not the Game Boy game, so not used. Composites committed under live/2026-10-23/gb-classics/. Hook: three games join, one produced by Miyamoto (ties to his Order of Culture today).
